description:
Send SMS, MMS and WhatsApp messages from your Bubble app through Plivo's global messaging network. Whether it is a one-time passcode, a delivery update, an appointment reminder or a media-rich campaign, one action covers it — set the sender, the recipient, the text and, when you need it, the media. Delivery history stays queryable, so you can show message status inside your own app.

Key Features:
✉️ SMS, MMS & WhatsApp: A single Send Message action handles plain text, media attachments and WhatsApp delivery by switching the message type.

🖼️ Media Support: Attach image, audio, video or document URLs for MMS and WhatsApp sends.

📜 Message History: List all messages or retrieve a single message to build inboxes, audit logs and delivery dashboards.

🌍 Global Reach: Plivo's carrier network covers 190+ countries with local number support.

🔐 Simple Auth: Your Plivo Auth ID and Auth Token go in the plugin settings and stay on the server.

Plugin support: https://inova.us/support
name: Plivo - Messaging SMS MMS WA
plugin_instructions:
HOW IT WORKS
1. Create an account at plivo.com.
2. Purchase a phone number within your Plivo account.
3. Navigate to Messaging > Overview in the Plivo dashboard.
4. Copy your Auth ID and paste it into the plugin’s username field.
5. Copy your Auth Token and paste it into the plugin’s password field.
6.Use the “Send Message” action in the plugin to send your first message.
